Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Implement email verification system

Database Changes:
- Added VerificationToken model to Prisma schema
  - Stores verification tokens with userId, type, expiresAt
  - Unique token constraint for security
  - Cascading delete on user deletion
  - Indexed on userId, token, expiresAt for performance

API Endpoints:
- GET /api/auth/verify-email
  - Validates token from query parameter
  - Checks expiration (24 hours)
  - Updates user.emailVerified to true
  - Deletes used token
  - Handles already-verified and expired cases

- POST /api/auth/resend-verification
  - Protected with withAuth middleware
  - Deletes old unused tokens
  - Generates new 24-hour token
  - Sends verification email

Email System:
- Added sendVerificationEmail() function
  - Professional HTML template with CTA button
  - Includes verification link with token
  - 24-hour expiration notice
  - Fallback text link for accessibility

Registration Flow:
- Generates verification token after user creation
- Stores token in database with 24-hour expiration
- Sends welcome email (existing)
- Sends verification email (new)
  - Both emails fire-and-forget (don''t block registration)
- Removed TODO comment

Verification Page:
- Client-side page at /verify-email
- Reads token from URL query param
- Calls API endpoint to verify
- Shows loading, success, error, or already-verified states
- Auto-redirects to dashboard on success (3 seconds)
- Provides navigation options on error

Settings Page Updates:
- Shows email verification status badge (Verified/Unverified)
- Yellow alert banner if email not verified
- "Resend Email" button with loading state
- Fetches and displays emailVerified from /api/auth/me
- Toast notifications for resend success/error

Security Features:
- Cryptographically secure random tokens (32 bytes)
- Token expiration after 24 hours
- One-time use tokens (deleted after verification)
- Prevents duplicate verification
- Protected resend endpoint (requires auth)

User Experience:
- Two separate emails (welcome + verification)
- Clear verification status in settings
- Easy resend functionality
- Professional email templates
- Informative success/error messages
